name: vca_cascade_warm_failed_@ENV@
description: venue-call-agent (@SERVICE@): the speech cascade failed to warm up (cascade_warm_failed) or could not start at all (cascade_unavailable). Source lines: ops/monitoring/README.md.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="@SERVICE@" AND log_id("run.googleapis.com/stderr") AND textPayload=~"^cascade_(warm_failed|unavailable) "
